sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW transparent pixel-art slot-machine sprite for a Pokémon-style overhead interior. Recreate from zero. ABSOLUTE CAMERA REQUIREMENT: orthographic camera almost vertically overhead, 88–90 degrees above the floor, NOT a front view, NOT a side view, NOT isometric, NOT a 45-degree three-quarter view. At least 92% of the visible machine must be its horizontal TOP SURFACE. A vertical rectangular machine footprint, green enamel casing with thin warm gold trim, THREE reel windows inset directly into the upward-facing flat horizontal console, tiny red/yellow buttons on this same top plane, a very small gold indicator at top-right. An almost imperceptible 2–3 pixel thick lower edge is the ONLY visible depth; no tall upright façade, no vertical screen, no visible legs, no pedestal. Whole silhouette narrow and elongated vertically, width:height about 48:68. Every long edge parallel to image vertical axis, short edges horizontal. Simple dark-outlined chunky pixel art, restrained 3-tone shading, forest green and gold to fit a burgundy casino room. Readable as a clean native 48x68 sprite. Completely isolated on true transparent alpha, no floor, no cast shadow, no text/logo/watermark, no border frame. The surface facing the ceiling must completely dominate.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW production transparent pixel-art furniture spritesheet. Draw from scratch EXACTLY 2 columns and 6 evenly spaced rows (12 sprites), each centered fully inside its uniform cell with generous empty alpha margins. Column 1 faces EAST/right, column 2 faces WEST/left. ABSOLUTE CAMERA: almost perfectly VERTICAL OVERHEAD orthographic, 88–90 degrees above floor. TOP SURFACES take 90–95% of each object. Only a tiny 1–2 pixel edge suggests thickness. NO traditional side elevation, NO three-quarter view, NO diagonal isometric axes, NO tall visible facades or legs. Furniture is aligned with horizontal/vertical floor axes. Row 1: round brown wooden tabletop, nearly circular seen from directly above, very thin rim. Row 2: small wooden chair, red square SEAT dominates, backrest appears only as a thin strip along LEFT edge in east view and RIGHT edge in west view. Row 3: long BLUE three-seat sofa, THREE large square blue cushion TOPS arranged VERTICALLY, back is only a thin strip on LEFT edge (east) / RIGHT edge (west), slim arm tops at short top/bottom ends; never a visible tall blue side wall. Row 4: wooden wardrobe seen from ABOVE, large rectangular warm brown TOP PANEL, narrow hinge/door edge on right/left, absolutely no tall door facade. Row 5: wooden bookcase seen from ABOVE, large bare wooden TOP dominates, only a very narrow line of red/blue book spines at the right/left edge. Row 6: wooden writing desk seen from ABOVE, clear broad wood DESKTOP dominates, tiny shallow drawer edge at right/left, no visible legs. For rows 3/4/5/6 the long axis runs VERTICALLY (far end at image top), matching a 90-degree rotated rectangular footprint. Simple clean chunky Pokémon RPG pixel art, dark outlines, sparse 3-tone shading, restrained brown/red/blue colors, readable at 16–32 pixels wide and 26–52 tall. Do not draw fronts/backs or beds. No text, no labels, no ground, no shadows outside objects, true transparent alpha. The overhead perspective is mandatory in EVERY cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW transparent pixel-art furniture sprite sheet, built from scratch. Strict grid: EXACTLY 2 columns and 6 equally spaced rows; 12 complete isolated sprites with generous alpha margins. Left column EAST-facing, right column WEST-facing. CRUCIAL CAMERA: 88–90-degree VERTICAL OVERHEAD orthographic. At least 90–95% of the visible object is its TOP plane. Barely 1–2 pixels of thickness at an edge, NO pronounced three-quarter view, NO side elevation, NO tall cabinet walls, NO legs, no diagonal isometric axes. Ground axes horizontal/vertical. All rectangular objects' long axis is VERTICAL, as though placed sideways in a Pokémon room. Row 1: rectangular AQUARIUM, almost everything is blue WATER SURFACE seen from overhead with two tiny fish pixels, thin glass/wood rim; no tall blue front panel. Row 2: brown wooden TREASURE CHEST, broad wood LID with thin silver metal bands dominates, only an almost invisible short side edge. Row 3: long GREEN THREE-SEAT SOFA, three square green cushion TOPS arranged vertically; very thin backrest strip on LEFT edge in east-facing and RIGHT edge in west-facing, narrow armrest tops at ends; NO large side panel. Row 4: small cream-topped wooden SIDE TABLE, full pale tabletop dominates, very thin brown rim, no legs. Row 5: small BLUE POKEMON COMPUTER, flat upward-facing blue screen and light keyboard visible FROM ABOVE; the screen is nearly horizontal, not an upright monitor seen from the side, screen located on left edge for east and right for west. Row 6: RED AND WHITE POKEMON HEALING STATION, broad white/red top deck with SIX small Pokéball sockets seen from ABOVE, tiny dark edge only; no vertical medical-machine facade. Simple chunky pixel art with clean dark outlines, minimal shading, brown/blue/green/red-white palette, matching Pokémon RPG furniture at 16–28px wide by 22–52px tall. No labels, no text, no numbers, no beds, no front or rear views, no floor or cast shadow. True transparent alpha. Overhead top dominance in EVERY sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: new transparent pixel-art spritesheet with EXACTLY TWO sprites, side by side, ample empty alpha padding. They are the two lateral orientations of ONE long THREE-SEAT SOFA, almost perfectly VERTICAL OVERHEAD orthographic camera 89 degrees above the floor. NOT side elevation, NOT isometric, no three-quarter angle. Muted SLATE BLUE upholstery (dark navy outline, medium denim blue #4e669b, pale blue highlights), not bright electric blue. Each sofa long axis VERTICAL. In the LEFT sprite, three broad square SEAT TOPS form a vertical stack, with ONE very thin continuous backrest strip down its LEFT long edge, slim arm tops across short top/bottom ends. In the RIGHT sprite, three seat tops stack vertically, with that thin backrest strip down its RIGHT long edge. This difference must be unmistakable, these sprites face opposite directions EAST and WEST. Seat surfaces occupy 85–90% of width, back strip only 10%, no tall exterior walls, almost no front edge, no visible legs. Silhouette roughly 28 wide by 52 high when reduced to game pixels. Same sofa design and three cushions in both. Crisp chunky Pokémon interior pixel art, dark outlines, very sparse 3-tone shading. TRUE transparent background, no glowing halos or colored aura, no floor, no cast shadow, no labels, no text, no other objects.
